    Profile

    Kalmia is a knight of Envylia, known far and wide for her mastery of the spear. Believing that one negative emotion leads to another, she hides her anger behind a smile and always maintains a calm appearance. Only Priscilla, who grew up like her sister under the same master, knows her true smile.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 163cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Sep 5
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Hard workers
    Hobbies: Helping take care of flowers
    Illust: uessa（G-ROW）
    CV: 永牟田萌
